remediatedFindings.threat: Dynamic SQL string concatenation in SET LOCAL session variables could allow SQL injection if single-quote sanitization is bypassed.
remediatedFindings.expectedBehavior: Session variables are bound via native PostgreSQL parameterized queries without string interpolation.
remediatedFindings.actualBehavior: String concatenation (`SET LOCAL app.current_tenant_id = '${...}'`) and sql.raw was used.
remediatedFindings.rootCause: Direct string interpolation was utilized instead of PostgreSQL set_config standard function.
remediatedFindings.remediation: Replaced with parameterized `SELECT set_config('app.current_tenant_id', ${tenantId}, true)` using Drizzle sql tag parameter binding.
remediatedFindings.targetedTest: SQLI-02: Remediated parameterized set_config executes without syntax error

remediatedFindings.threat: Unauthenticated caller could retrieve live directory of all registered healthcare partners including full names, personal phone numbers, emails, and plan tiers.
remediatedFindings.expectedBehavior: Route requires authentication and company admin privileges.
remediatedFindings.rootCause: Missing preHandler authentication hook on public endpoint alias.

remediatedFindings.threat: Malformed or empty JSON payloads in device heartbeat endpoint triggered unhandled exceptions and defaulted tenantId to invalid zeroes.
remediatedFindings.expectedBehavior: Payload is validated via Zod schema and tenantId header is strictly required.
remediatedFindings.actualBehavior: Handler accepted unvalidated raw object causing type errors.
remediatedFindings.rootCause: Missing Zod validation schema on device telemetry heartbeat route.
remediatedFindings.remediation: Implemented `DeviceHeartbeatSchema` with strict string validation and mandatory `x-tenant-id` header validation.
remediatedFindings.targetedTest: VAL-01 (Empty body rejected 400) and VAL-02 (Missing tenant header rejected 400)

remediatedFindings.threat: Public health check endpoint /api/v1/health was omitted from the rate limit allowList, subjecting cloud load balancers and orchestrator probes to 429 throttling.
remediatedFindings.expectedBehavior: Standard public health endpoint /api/v1/health is exempted from rate limiting.
remediatedFindings.actualBehavior: Only /health and /healthz were in allowList; /api/v1/health consumed unauthenticated rate quota.
remediatedFindings.rootCause: Omission of /api/v1/health prefix in rate limit allowList predicate.
remediatedFindings.targetedTest: HEAD-02: Health check endpoint /api/v1/health verified operational and safe

remediatedFindings.threat: Employee codes, names, emails, and passwords interpolated into printed voucher HTML without entity encoding could execute arbitrary script in the print window.
remediatedFindings.expectedBehavior: All dynamic variables in printed HTML slips are entity-encoded before insertion.
remediatedFindings.actualBehavior: Raw values were inserted into document.write template literal.
remediatedFindings.rootCause: Lack of HTML entity escaping on credential slip generation.
remediatedFindings.remediation: Added `escapeHtml` utility and sanitized all interpolated credentials before writing to document.

remediatedFindings.threat: Frontend activity dock called non-existent /api/health instead of /api/v1/health, triggering continuous 404 connection errors.
remediatedFindings.actualBehavior: Called /api/health returning 404 and displaying OFFLINE status.
remediatedFindings.targetedTest: Frontend compilation and network routing verification
